label: Ferma
description: Ferma, the palette of the lab template «Натуральные продукты» (16.09 templates lab, t-2026-10-12-33 T0a). Light only (no modes.dark): the lab drew no dark mode and the generator has no rule to derive one, so themes:build paints these tokens under both data-mode values. The lab has no --chart-*: they take the lab's own role colours in the order the bridge reads them as tag hues (1 blue = --link, 2 green = --success, 3 purple = --accent-foreground, 4 red = --destructive, 5 orange = --warning). The lab's --surface-media has no canon row and is not carried.
